events.title: Seferia Faculty of Magic Notice — 1.5.2: Gem Upgrade System Overhaul
events.summary: A message from the Seferia Faculty of Magic. Greetings, Mage. Patch 1.5.2 overhauls the upgrade system for the Gems that dwell in your dice — Augments and Imprints. Until now a Gem's effect leaned on chance and could be unreliable; from now on, each Gem takes a fixed place on your dice and grows stronger with every upgrade. events.title: From the Seferia Faculty of Magic — Selected for Unite Seoul & IndieCraft
events.summary: A message from the Seferia Faculty of Magic. Greetings, Mage. Today we bring you some happy news. Seferia: Matrix has been selected to exhibit at both Unite Seoul and IndieCraft. Unite Seoul is a major conference that Unity holds each year across different countries. Seferia: Matrix has been selected for its 2026 Indie Game Showcase and will be on display for several days starting July 19. events.title: From the Seferia Faculty of Magic — 1.3.6: Cooler, Smoother Play
events.summary: A message from the Seferia Faculty of Magic. Greetings, Mage. Here's what this 1.3.6 patch brings: - The frame rate is now capped at 60 FPS, reducing the heat and power draw that built up during long play sessions — along with the slowdowns (lag) they caused. This is especially noticeable on laptops and handhelds. Thank you.

events.title: From the Seferia Faculty of Magic — 1.3.5: See What You Can Cast
events.summary: A message from the Seferia Faculty of Magic. Greetings, Mage. Here's what this 1.3.5 patch brings: - When you Formulate Phases, the Spells you can Cast with the Phases in your current hand are now shown. It's easier to see what you can Cast based on your current hand. - A variety of error toast messages have been added. events.title: Patch 1.3.4 — Tutorial Bug Fixes
events.summary: Patch 1.3.4 has been released. Bug Fixes - Fixed a controller input error on tutorial popups. - Fixed an issue where tutorial popup buttons could be displayed off-screen. Thank you for playing.

events.title: Dimension Decipher Comes to Every School
events.summary: An announcement from the Administration of the Seferia Magic Academy. Dimension Decipher has been added to every curriculum. Dimension Decipher is the art of reaching into the origin of the dimensions — the three universes that compose Seferia — and shaping reality itself. With this addition, every mage may now pursue their chosen path of magic with greater efficiency and precision.
